profile.summary: Reliance Chemotex Industries Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of synthetic and blended yarns in India. The company offers home furnishing yarns, such as carpets, upholstery, and automotive; industrial yarns, such as awnings, protective wear, medical aids, and filtration; apparel yarns, such as knitwear, suiting, and melange; and technical and dope-dyed yarns.
